title: Allowed workout types by week and beginner eligibility

runner_eligibility.eligible_profile: Adult beginner working toward completing 5 kilometres with walking allowed, not a time goal
runner_eligibility.current_training_requirement: No running history or limited recent running; not suitable for advanced performance goals
runner_eligibility.note: These are first-release product-scope gates, not medical clearance or diagnostic screening.

training_rules.optional_cross_training: Not part of this initial approved plan; no extra scheduled load by default.
training_rules.selection_algorithm: Exact phase/week/role lookup. Do not substitute a workout from NYRR Conservative/Moderate/Advanced based only on matching distance.

fallback_rules.request_for_quality_workout: Refer to a separately reviewed non-beginner plan; do not auto-upgrade

evidence_sources.title: NHS Better Health - Couch to 5K running plan
evidence_sources.supports: Beginner run/walk programming, 3 run days per week, rest days between runs, five-minute walking warm-up and cool-down, self-paced effort. NHS uses 9 weeks; this pack is an original 12-week proposal, not the NHS schedule.

evidence_sources.title: NYRR 5K Training Plan Conservative (12 Weeks)
evidence_sources.supports: Reference for RPE descriptors, structured sessions and 5K goal race. NOT a true zero-running beginner schedule: includes early speedwork and tempo sessions.

evidence_sources.title: NYRR 5K Training Plan Moderate (12 Weeks)
evidence_sources.supports: Comparison only. Contains high-mileage quality sessions; not copied into true-beginner schedule.

evidence_sources.title: NYRR 5K Training Plan Advanced (12 Weeks)
evidence_sources.supports: Comparison only. Requires established training background; not copied into true-beginner schedule.

notes: DRAFT. Numerical tables are original engineering proposals needing coaching validation. Do not describe as an NYRR or NHS exact plan.
